items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: I remember going to the show... Gershwin had appeared -- they put the show on for a whole week... So I remember going there one day and I went upstairs and he says, 'You're fired.'

ctx.x: That's the date I received. 1930, in June. It came to the Roxy and at that time Paul had been complaining about the band, that the band business was lousy and the only thing that he was depending on mostly was the Old Gold Show and well, anyway, they brought the picture into the Roxy, it could have been May, but anyway at that particular time, they brought it into the Roxy, and Gershwin appeared with them and the Rhythm Boys had not come back with them now, which probably doesn't make any difference, as far as…
So I remember going there one day and I went upstairs and he says, "You're fired."
